$comment: Manifest for GET /submission-templates. A submission template says what ONE authority wants of a drawing set: which sheets, in which order, on what paper, and which statutory identifiers must appear in the title block. It is deliberately NOT the rule pack — a rule pack answers 'is this design legal', a template answers 'is this SET submittable'. Bengaluru is why the two are separate: BBMP and BDA sanction different plots under the same blr rule pack and want different sets.

reviewNote: Every template below is a SEED. The sheet list reflects the conventional Indian plan-sanction set and this product's own drawing vocabulary; it has not been checked against any authority's current published checklist.
